blocks.text: Survey bohat sara data structured (tarteeb wale, ek jaise) tareeqe se jama karne ka aam tareeqa hai. Is mein ek sample group (logon ke chhote group) se predefined (pehle se tay kiye hue) sawal pooche jate hain. Survey online forms, telephone calls ya face-to-face (aamne saamne) interviews se kiya ja sakta hai.

Misal: Islamabad ki ek chhoti grocery dukaan jaanna chahti hai ke customers kaunsi cheezein zyada dekhna (dukaan par zyada milna) chahte hain. Woh paanch sawalon ka chhota survey banati hai (kitab ki figure mein dikhaya gaya, neeche list) aur weekend par 50 customers mein baant deti hai. Jawabon ko analyze kar ke dukaan wohi saaman rakhti hai jo customers chahte hain, aur business behtar chalta hai.
Customer Preference Survey (customers ki pasand ka survey)

items: Aap kaunsi qism ki cheezein sab se zyada khareedte hain? (maslan phal, sabziyan, doodh se bani cheezein)
Kya koi cheezein hain jo aap zyada dekhna chahte hain?
Aap is dukaan par kitni baar aate hain? (maslan rozana, haftawar, mahana)
Khareedari ka faisla sab se zyada kis cheez se hota hai? (maslan qeemat, quality, cheez milti hai ya nahi)

blocks.text: Jawab weekend par 50 customers se jama kiye gaye.

blocks.prompt: Survey ka ek faida aur ek kamzori bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Faida: kam waqt mein bohat se logon ke jawab, ek jaisi shakal mein jinhein aapas mein compare kar sakte hain (mila sakte hain). Kamzori: log be-parwahi se ya ghalat jawab de sakte hain, aur sirf woh log gine jate hain jo jawab dein (yeh kamzori aam knowledge hai, kitab mein nahi).

items: Survey: sample group se pehle se tay sawal (online, phone, aamne saamne); misal: 50 grocery customers.
